t.id: karena Kami hendak merasakan pada mereka
t.en: that We may make them taste
But surely We will cause to taste

t.id: dan sungguh Kami akan memberi balasan mereka
t.en: and surely We will recompense them
then it is for his soul

t.id: dan sungguh akan Kami rasakan kepada mereka
t.en: and We will surely make them taste
